free_text_notes.physician_note: 63-year-old woman with former smoker (40 pack-years), GERD, admitted 6/15 with COPD exacerbation triggered by viral bronchitis. Ambulated 100 m with PT yesterday without desaturation.
free_text_notes.nursing_note: Ambulated in hallway with son present. Still waiting on pharmacy to finish the medication reconciliation. Patient asked what the new tiotropium 18 mcg inhaled daily is for; teaching still needed. A mild rash appeared briefly at the IV insertion site on day 2. It was assessed as a minor irritation, treated with a topical cream, and has fully resolved.
free_text_notes.case_manager_note: Met with patient and son to review the discharge plan. Patient asked to move the pulmonology clinic appointment; rebooked within 14 days of discharge.
